evals.name: should-trigger-verify-deploy-by-sha
evals.prompt: I just pushed to the integration branch. Wait until my deploy is live on Vercel and tell me when it's READY.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates vercel-cli. Finds the deployment with vercel ls -m githubCommitSha=<sha> --format json and jq, retries while the webhook registers, then runs vercel inspect <url> --wait --timeout=10m and reports the exit code. Never greps the plain vercel ls output.

evals.name: should-trigger-sync-env-names
evals.prompt: Sync the keys from .env.example to the Vercel Preview scope, some are missing there.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates vercel-cli and reads references/env-vars.md. Runs vercel whoami and checks .vercel/project.json, diffs key NAMES from .env.example against vercel env ls preview --format json, and moves values through the varlock subprocess by name. Never opens .env or prints a value.

evals.name: should-trigger-es-logs-build-fallo
evals.prompt: Falló el build en Vercel, puedes mostrarme los logs del deploy para ver qué pasó?
evals.expected_behavior: Activates vercel-cli and reads references/debugging.md. Runs vercel inspect <url> --logs for the build log, checks the state field to separate build from runtime, and maps the error to the common causes (missing env var, type error, module not found).

evals.name: should-trigger-es-rollback-produccion
evals.prompt: Producción está rota después del último deploy, haz rollback al deploy anterior de Vercel.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates vercel-cli and reads references/rollback.md. Finds the previous READY production deploy with vercel ls --prod --status READY --format json. Because rollback is an outward action, runs vercel rollback only when the person or the delegating brief asked for it; otherwise reports the candidate deploy and stops. Notes that a rollback cannot undo DB migrations.

evals.name: should-trigger-link-state
evals.prompt: Is this repo linked to a Vercel project? Check without changing anything.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates vercel-cli and reads references/linking.md. Checks for .vercel/project.json or .vercel/repo.json by reading the files, and uses vercel whoami as the only probe. Does not run vercel ls, vercel project inspect or vercel link.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-choose-deploy-method
evals.prompt: I have never deployed this app. Which way should I deploy it to Vercel, and can you link it for the first time?
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate vercel-cli. Defers to the community deploy-to-vercel skill, which owns deploy method selection and the first-time link.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-netlify-deploy
evals.prompt: Deploy this site to Netlify and set the environment variables there.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate vercel-cli. Netlify is out of scope for a Vercel CLI cookbook.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-supabase-env-values
evals.prompt: What is the value of SUPABASE_URL for staging? Look it up in the database dashboard.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate vercel-cli. Supabase is the source of truth for those values and Vercel only mirrors them; the question belongs to the Supabase MCP.
